content.text: Where to buy Michigan Wolverines National Champions merchFanaticsIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Jessica Day | jday@masslive.comMichigan defeated UConn 69-63 in a thrilling national championship game on April 6, 2026, capturing the program’s second title in history and first since 1989. Led by Big Ten Player of the Year Yaxel Lendeborg and despite playing injured, the Wolverines powered through one of the most dominant tournament runs in recent memory, scoring 90+ points in their first five games.
